results.question: What is an Internet Export Declaration Plus (IAA-Plus)?
results.reference: In connection with the introduction of ATLAS Export (Release 2.0), it has been possible since May 4, 2009 to complete export declarations online on the Internet and submit them with an electronic certificate if the export shipment is declared at a German customs office of export. The customs administration uses the ELSTER certificate, which is already accepted by all federal states for paperless tax declarations, and thus makes it possible to dispense with the signature. With the electronic certificate, customs offices can determine the origin of incoming export declarations and at the same time transmit all customs decisions on the transfer of goods to the export procedure back to the sender. This means that, for the first time, economic operators can process all essential simplifications completely paperless via the Internet. It is no longer necessary to submit a hand-signed export declaration to the customs office of export. Replies from the customs office of export will be sent to the trader.
